result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues: category chips and restaurant cards overflow the screen, and a popular listing is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped so the name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and the image is cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Give the last card enough inset/padding or snap the carousel so full cards (or a clear peek) remain fully visible.

issues.description: The last item in the 'Popular right now' list is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so list content can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right; 'Healthy' is partially cut off with no clear indication of more categories.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and a fade/overflow affordance so users can tell the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The green promo banner uses very light/white body copy on a mid-green background, which may be hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of the secondary promo text (e.g., darker or fully white with stronger weight).
